from orders.application.customer_service import CustomerService

from orders.controllers.customers import CustomerController
from orders.controllers.orders import OrderController

from orders.infrastructure.catalog import InMemoryProductCatalog
from orders.infrastructure.customers import InMemoryCustomerRepository
from orders.infrastructure.repository import InMemoryOrderRepository
from orders.infrastructure.stock import InMemoryStockRepository


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Api:
    customers: CustomerController
    catalog: CatalogController
    orders: OrderController
    reports: ReportsController


def build_app() -> Api:
    orders = InMemoryOrderRepository()
    customers = InMemoryCustomerRepository()
    catalog = InMemoryProductCatalog()
    stock = InMemoryStockRepository()
    return Api(
        customers=CustomerController(CustomerService(customers)),
        catalog=CatalogController(CatalogService(catalog, stock)),
        orders=OrderController(OrderService(orders, customers, catalog, stock)),
        reports=ReportsController(orders),
    )

                "quantity": item.quantity,
            })

            "order_id": order.order_id,
            "customer_name": customer.name if customer else "",

23	        self._catalog = catalog

26	    def get_packing_slip(self, order_id: str) -> dict:
27	        order = self._orders.get(order_id)
28	        if order is None:
29	            raise OrderNotFound(order_id)
30	
31	        if order.status == "cancelled":
32	            raise Conflict("cannot pack a cancelled order")
33	
34	        customer = self._customers.get(order.customer_id)
35	        lines = []
36	        for item in order.items:
37	            product = self._catalog.get(item.sku)
38	            lines.append({
39	                "sku": item.sku,
40	                "name": product.name if product else item.sku,
41	                "quantity": item.quantity,
42	            })
43	
44	        return {
45	            "order_id": order.order_id,
46	            "customer_name": customer.name if customer else "",
47	            "lines": lines,
48	        }

51	        products = []
52	        for product in self._catalog.list_all():
53	            if product.active and self._stock.get(product.sku) < threshold:
54	                products.append({
55	                    "sku": product.sku,
56	                    "name": product.name,
57	                    "on_hand": self._stock.get(product.sku),
58	                })
59	        products.sort(key=lambda p: (p["on_hand"], p["sku"]))
60	        return products

63	        product = self._catalog.get(sku)
